user.title: Al Quran Cloud
user.description: Play Al Quran Cloud. Audio joins the ayah MP3s. Surah video opens the player in an LG, Samsung, or Android TV browser.

data_description.display_language: Language used for reciter and surah names.
data_description.cache_days: How many days to keep a joined MP3 before building it again (1-90).
data_description.playback_speed: Speeds other than 1 need ffmpeg and an HTTPS Home Assistant URL. Surah video sends this speed to the TV browser.
data_description.show_picture: Open the Quran player in the browser of an LG, Samsung, or Android TV. Home Assistant does not follow the ayah after that.
data_description.favorite_reciters: Shown at the top of the Al Quran Cloud media source after the catalog loads.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Al Quran Cloud configuration is allowed.
